Create a 2D skeletal animation asset kit for the EXACT soldier in olive camouflage, helmet, kneepads and small rifle supported in both hands in the reference. This is NOT a walk sprite sheet. Paint three separate cutout COMPONENTS in ONE ROW, THREE EQUAL COLUMNS with empty gutters. Realistic painted VORO art, elevated side camera, character faces RIGHT. No whole-body person anywhere. Maintain reference costume, face, hair, equipment, lighting.
LEFT COLUMN: ONLY the upper body, head, neck, torso, arms, accessories and pelvis/hip area. Omit both legs entirely, no thighs, no feet. Torso in calm upright side-view orientation facing RIGHT.    Torso has complete opaque clothing around pelvis so it can hide leg joints.
MIDDLE COLUMN: ONE isolated upper-leg/thigh piece ONLY, from hidden hip joint to rounded knee, straight vertical neutral orientation, matching trousers/armor. No pelvis, no torso, NO lower leg, NO shoe. Top and bottom painted as rounded solid caps with generous overlap for rotating joints. Length about 30% of torso height. The visible outside surface is nearest camera.
RIGHT COLUMN: ONE isolated lower-leg piece ONLY, from rounded knee joint to ankle and complete shoe/boot. Vertical shin with foot pointing SCREEN RIGHT, flat sole. Matching clothing/armor/footwear. No thigh, no torso. Rounded opaque upper cap for overlap at knee. Length including boot about 35% of torso height.
All three parts share EXACT pixel scale and side camera angle. Each separate piece must be entire and uncut. These pieces will be rotated at hips and knees by code and duplicated for the far leg; include authentic folds and shading but clean overlap caps. No second leg or repeated pose. Clean transparent background; zero haze, glow, scenery, ground or labels. Leave padding, keep pieces strictly in their own third of sheet.
